own_scenes.family: Metal extremo: death, black y grind
own_scenes.desc: En polo opuesto al metal cristiano: no mira al cielo sino al inframundo. Los símbolos satánicos son materia del heavy desde Black Sabbath y Led Zeppelin, porque en Occidente no hay mejor símbolo de rebeldía, pero grupos como Mercyful Fate afirman que no juegan: se dicen verdaderos creyentes, algo que muchos ven como una treta comercial. Hay muy pocas bandas exclusivamente de black metal; es más una categoría temática que inspira canciones que un subgénero musical.

influences.name: New Wave of British Heavy Metal

refs.q: Black metal stands in thematic opposition to Christianity, not looking upward to heaven but setting its sights on the underworld.
refs.para: Black metal stands in thematic opposition to Christianity, not looking upward to heaven but setting its sights on the underworld. Satanic symbols and imagery have been a staple of heavy metal since its beginnings with Black Sabbath and Led Zeppelin. In the West there is no better symbol of rebellion. But groups such as Mercyful Fate claimed that they were not playing. Their claims to be true believers, followers of the lord of the underworld, were seen by many to be a commercial ploy. There are very few bands that could be called exclusively black metal, but the category is an acknowledged and logical one for the genre as a whole, inspiring songs, if not albums or the entire output of bands.

similar_scenes.name: Black metal noruego
similar_scenes.book: Heavy Metal: The Music and Its Culture
similar_scenes.author: Deena Weinstein
similar_scenes.desc: El término viene de una canción de Venom, pero en los noventa ya no designa una temática sino un estilo sonoro nacido en Noruega con Mayhem y Burzum: sobre una base de death metal añade capas de teclados cósmicos, voces chirriantes y músicos pintados de cadáver. Sus fundadores se tomaban en serio el satanismo: profanaciones de cementerios, iglesias quemadas y asesinatos que, como los antecedentes de los gangsta rappers, le dieron un aire de autenticidad. Crece exponencialmente en el norte de Europa (Emperor y Dimmu Borgir ya cruzan el Atlántico) y a su vez se fragmenta hacia lo new age (Tiamat, Burzum) o hacia el gótico (Cradle of Filth, Theatre of Tragedy).

similar_scenes.name: Metal de los noventa: progresivo, death y black metal
similar_scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
similar_scenes.desc: Si los ochenta fueron la edad de oro del heavy metal, los noventa lo fragmentan en estilos que amplían ideas anteriores. El pop-metal (Warrant, Extreme, Live) es lo menos significativo; Marilyn Manson casa el scum-rock de Alice Cooper con el industrial de Nine Inch Nails. El metal progresivo (Warrior Soul, Dream Theater, Royal Hunt, Opeth, los suizos Alboth!). El death metal muta en algo más terrible y más musical gracias a Brutal Truth, Cannibal Corpse y, sobre todo, la tríada de Type O Negative (Slow Deep And Hard, misas negras wagnerianas), Today Is The Day y Fear Factory; Biohazard, Coalesce, Dillinger Escape Plan. El nuevo black metal escandinavo: Entombed, Darkthrone, Immortal, Mayhem, Enslaved, Emperor, Satyricon, Cradle Of Filth.

podcast.title: Corpse Paint Comparison
podcast.body: The corpse paint worn by Peter Ebling, the singer of the fictional band The Undead in the 1974 film "Phantom of the Paradise," is compared to what is seen in modern black metal, suggesting an early visual precursor to the genre.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Instrumental Passages for Atmosphere
podcast.body: Many Black Metal albums incorporated instrumental pieces to imbue the overall work with an epic and atmospheric, often cinematic and somber, quality. These instrumentals, notably in bands like Slay (likely a typo for a Black Metal band, or 'Slate' as per transcript) and Emperor, began to gain more notoriety and were foundational for the emergence of Dungeon Synth. "Muchos de los discos de la escena contendían piensas instrumentales que buscaban darle una idea épico y atmosférico al conjunto del disco."

srcs.episode: Dungeon Synth: El género más misterioso de internet

podcast.title: Norwegian Epicenter (Late 1980s / Early 1990s)
podcast.body: Norway became the central hub for this extreme, dark, and radically countercultural musical genre, with bands like Mayhem, Darkthrone, and Emperor defining its rawness. "La finales de los 80 y principios de los 90, Noruega fue el epicentro de un género musical extremo, oscuro y radicalmente contracultural."

srcs.episode: Dungeon Synth: El género más misterioso de internet

podcast.title: Satanic Invocation
podcast.body: Black Metal (referred to as "block into death metal") is a genre that frequently aims to invoke Satan. "Yeah, block into death metal, which intends to invoke Satan a lot."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Violence and Criminal Activity
podcast.body: The black metal genre has been associated with various violent and criminal acts perpetrated by its members. Examples include Gawl of Gorgoroth being jailed for torture, Faust of Emperor serving 14 years for murder, and Vargh Vikernes of Burzum receiving 21 years for stabbing a rival band member 23 times. "Gawl, a member of a black metal band called Gorgoroth, got a 14-month jail sentence for torture."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
